slide1.headline: OpenAI's Record-Breaking Funding
slide1.subtitle: A new era in AI development

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: OpenAI unveiled $110B in funding on 27 Feb 2026
The funding round is one of the largest in history
It will be used to further develop AI technology
And expand its AWS partnership

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The funding will accelerate AI innovation
And increase competition in the AI market
It will also lead to new job opportunities
And drive economic growth

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The funding round is a significant milestone for OpenAI
It will enable the company to further develop its AI technology
And expand its partnerships with other companies

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: RadNet acquired AI radiology tech company Gleamer for $270 million on 03 Mar 2026
The acquisition will expand RadNet's AI radiology capabilities
And improve its ability to diagnose and treat diseases
The deal is expected to close in the coming months

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The acquisition will enable RadNet to improve its AI radiology capabilities
And increase its competitiveness in the market
It will also lead to better patient outcomes
Source: Beijing Times, 03 Mar 2026

posts.caption: RadNet's acquisition of Gleamer will expand its AI radiology capabilities and improve patient outcomes. What do you think about the growing trend of AI acquisitions in the healthcare industry? #AI #Acquisition #Healthcare #RadNet #Gleamer

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Thales' 2026 Data Threat Report highlighted rising AI security risks on 26 Feb 2026
The report found that 75% of companies are concerned about AI security risks
And 60% of companies are investing in AI security measures
The report also found that the average cost of an AI security breach is $1.4 million

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The rising AI security risks are a growing concern for companies
And require immediate attention and investment
Companies must prioritize AI security to protect their data and systems
Source: Yahoo Finance, 26 Feb 2026
